summary: Torment Textures 1.1 by unknown author: 199 files (29.4 MB) — 197 images (57 pixel-art, mostly 129-512 px, 26 animation sequences), 1 docs/licenses.

content.description: Retro horror textures at 256x256 (wasteland pieces 512x512): blood-soaked stone, dripping blood falls, veined gore, rusted and painted metal panels, grates, cracked brick and cobble walls, rubble, dead earth and sand, and blood-red water. Two palette variants (Quake palette and true colour). Grim, hellish palette of reds, rust, charcoal and bone. Use for hell/dungeon/horror environments, Doom-like levels, or grimdark tile scenes.
